sentences.text:
The present petition has been filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India seeking the following reliefs:-
"(1) That, the respondents may kindly be restrained from encroaching over the petitioner's land survey No.422/2/1/1 (S) admeasuring area 0.3159 hectare situated at Dhaukalpura, Village Veerpur, Patwari Halka Ram Sewak Kushwah vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88057932/
1 - Veerpur, Tehsil Gwalior, District Gwalior (M.P.) without taking recourse to procedure prescribed for acquisition of land under the law.
(2) That, the respondents authorities may kindly be restrained from constructing the community hall over the petitioners' land.
(3) That, any other order or suitable writ order or direction in favour of the petitioner may kindly be passed in the interest of justice.
(4) The cost of the petition may kindly be allowed to the petitioners."

Counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is not aggrieved by any particular order,
but is aggrieved by the action of the respondents' authority, whereby the respondents/authority without following the mandatory provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (Land Acquisition Act, 2013) and without obtaining the consent of the petitioner, respondents authorities are trying to construct Community Hall over the petitioners land and in that regard the petitioner has also preferred a representation/application (Annexure P/3) but the same has not been decided till date by the respondents.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (Land Acquisition Act, 2013)
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: A limited prayer has been made by counsel for the petitioner that if the respondents/Authorities are directed to decide his pending representation/application dated 22.08.2023 (Annexure P/3) in accordance with law in a time bound manner, his grievance would be redressed.

Per contra, learned Additional Advocate General for the State submits that the present petition is totally misconceived as the petitioner had directly approached this Court without having approached the respondents/Authorities with regard to his grievance, but he candidly admits that if such directions are issued to the Collector, he has no objection.
After hearing learned counsel for the parties and looking to the limited prayer made by the counsel for the petitioner, the petition is disposed of with a direction to respondent No.3 i.e. Collector,
District Gwalior to look into the matter and take appropriate decision on the pending representation/application of the petitioner (Annexure P/3) by a reasoned and speaking order as expeditiously as possible preferably within a period of seven days from the date of receipt of the certified copy of this order in accordance with law.
With the aforesaid direction, petition is disposed of.
It is made clear that this Court has not expressed any opinion on the merits of the case.

(MILIND RAMESH PHADKE) JUDGE neetu Ram Sewak Kushwah vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88057932/
